title: Non-blocking LSL reconnect (resolve off the trust loop) + bounded demo char-LM memo
notes: Follow-up of the M6-13 soak test (reconnect blocked the loop up to 6.1 s; RefCharLM memo unbounded). fidetype.adapters.lsl: a loss starts a worker thread (_Reconnector) that runs reopen() (resolve + inlet open) and pre-warms time_correction(); poll() waits at most its timeout (min reconnect_handoff_s 5 ms); the wait goes to the first live inlet. LSLMapping.reconnect_mode thread (default) / inline (old path; the fep-0002 profile uses inline for determinism). Rules unchanged: loss aborts the utterance, reconnected status + new header order, reconnect_timeout_s raises and cancels the worker, close() cancels it. RefCharLM memo -> M4-10 LRUCache (32,768). Measurement experiments/2026-11-14-m6-14-nonblocking-reconnect (background CPU class; timing lock free but the causal-decoder agent was about to take it): real LSL producer restart, max loop step 5,556-5,607 ms inline vs 41.7-47.9 ms thread (1 of 6 runs 141.8 ms); p99 5.45-5.51 s vs 36-41 ms; reconnect step 707-753 ms vs 13-48 ms; fake 6 s resolve 6,003 vs 66.4 ms. Reconnect time unchanged (about 6.3 s: stale stream info + 5 s open_timeout; follow-up). Tests tests/test_lsl_reconnect.py (11, incl. a real-LSL restart check).
